Name: Snowfall
Description: Group containing parameters related to the simulation and appearance of light snow accumulation (dusting) on the terrain.

Name: Strength
Description: Controls the intensity of the snow dusting effect, determining how visible and thick the light snow layer appears.

Name: Snowline
Description: Sets the elevation at which snow begins to appear, defining the lower boundary for snow coverage.

Name: Falloff
Description: Controls the softness of the transition near the snowline, blending the snow edge smoothly into the terrain.

Name: Distribution
Description: Group containing parameters that affect how the snow is distributed across the terrain, including directionality and coverage.

Name: Directional
Description: Enables or adjusts wind-driven accumulation, causing snow to gather more on one side of terrain features.

Name: Direction
Description: Sets the primary direction for wind-driven snow accumulation, simulating the effect of prevailing winds.

Name: Peaks
Description: Controls additional snow accumulation on terrain peaks, enhancing coverage on high points.

Name: Coverage
Description: Adjusts the overall amount of snow applied to the terrain, increasing or decreasing the extent of dusting.

Name: Slope Coverage
Description: Modifies how much snow accumulates on slopes, allowing for more or less coverage on inclined surfaces.

Name: Flow
Description: Simulates subtle downhill drift and redistribution of snow, mimicking natural snow movement due to gravity.

Name: Effects
Description: Group containing additional effects that modify the appearance and realism of the snow dusting.

Name: Melt
Description: Reduces snow coverage in sun-exposed or warmer areas, simulating natural melting patterns.

Name: Gritty
Description: Adds noise and texture variation to the snow, creating a more natural, patchy, and irregular appearance.

Name: Include Existing Snow
Description: Allows the dusting effect to respect and blend with existing snow layers, ensuring seamless integration.

Name: Seed
Description: Randomizes the snow pattern, enabling varied results or reproducibility by changing the seed value.

Name: Artistic Control
Description: Provides fine-tuning options for the overall look and style of the snow dusting, supporting creative or stylized results.
